description: Record customer returns that were already processed in another system (a warehouse's daily returns feed, or a returns history) so demand velocity, daily consumption and the forecast net them. Without returns, demand is gross sales and is overstated. Each return: returnNumber (dedup identity), returnDate, optional salesOrderReference (the order number or customer PO / external order id of the sale), and lines of sku/upc + quantity + optional reason. The reason decides the netting: lost-demand reasons (not_needed, wrong_product, other, cancelled, or omitted) come off demand on the return date; real-demand reasons (defective, damaged, fulfillment_error, refunded_not_returned) are recorded but do not net. Returns without a sales order net too (weight 1, on their own date, for the credential's client); they are not treated as blind returns, so import or push the matching sales as well. Record-only: no receiving, no stock movement (stock comes from the inventory feed). Items must already exist (match by SKU, then UPC). Idempotent: a return number already imported for this client is skipped, so re-sending a day's feed is safe. Prefer 100 returns or fewer per call (500 max); pass the first result's importSessionId into later chunks of the same history. For a large file export use create_import_session with kind "customerReturnHistory" instead. Operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants pass clientId. Requires the governed two-step protocol: call with preview=true for the plan (would import / skip / fail with reasons, units that net demand vs not, order links resolved) plus a single-use previewReceipt, then repeat the identical call with that previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to commit — a bare call is refused with PREVIEW_RECEIPT_REQUIRED. rollback_import_session undoes a commit by its importSessionId.

clientId.description: Operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: the target client id (GUID) the returns belong to — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

importSessionId.description: Optional: the importSessionId returned by an earlier chunk of this SAME history — joins this chunk to that session so ONE rollback_import_session call undoes the whole import. Omit for a new import (each daily feed is its own).

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive the plan plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is recorded until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

returns.description: The returns to record (prefer 100 or fewer per call; hard max 500).

lines.description: The returned items. At least one required.

quantity.description: Units returned, in the item's unit of measure (> 0).

reason.description: Optional, decides whether the units net demand. Lost demand (the customer did not want the unit; NETS velocity, daily consumption and the forecast): not_needed, wrong_product, other, cancelled. Real demand (the sale was genuine; recorded but does NOT net): defective, damaged, fulfillment_error, refunded_not_returned. Omit when unknown: treated as lost demand, the default for customer returns. Whether the unit went back to sellable stock is not the question: restocked and scrapped units net the same way when the reason is lost demand. Any case and spaces/hyphens are accepted ("Not Needed").

sku.description: Item SKU (resolved first). The item must already exist.

upc.description: Item UPC/barcode, used when SKU is absent or unmatched.

note.description: Optional note stored on the return.

returnDate.description: REQUIRED. The date the return was processed (ISO 8601). Demand nets the return on this date. A value with a Z or offset is that instant; a bare date such as 2026-09-30 is that calendar day in the account's time zone (bound to local noon), and a bare timestamp is the account's wall-clock time. No future dates; nothing older than the 36 calendar months Spark keeps for demand.

returnNumber.description: REQUIRED. The return's number in the system that processed it (RMA, credit memo, return receipt id). Stored verbatim and used as the dedup identity: a return number already imported for this client is skipped, so re-sending a feed is safe.

salesOrderReference.description: Optional. The sales order the units were sold on: its order number, or the customer PO / external order id it was imported or pushed under. A linked return nets at that order's weight and client, and every item on it must be on that order with enough units left to return (otherwise the return is rejected). Omit when the feed has no order reference: the return still nets demand on its date. A reference that matches no order (or several) imports the return without the link and is reported in the preview.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) the units came back to; overrides the call's warehouseId. Get ids from list_warehouses.

Optional warehouse id (GUID) the returns came back to, for returns that name none. When neither is given a linked return takes its sales order's warehouse, and an unlinked one nets the item across its warehouses by their sales mix. Get ids from list_warehouses.
